name: Lena Brandt
summary: Senior Backend Engineer with 9 years of experience designing high-throughput distributed systems and data pipelines in tech enterprise environments. Specialized in Python microservice architectures, API performance tuning, and scalable database systems. Demonstrated track record of scaling core services, decreasing system latency, and lowering infrastructure spending.

experience.title: Senior Backend Engineer

Integrated Elasticsearch to power real-time inventory query tools across 14 global distribution hubs, maintaining 99.99% operational uptime.

experience.title: Backend Engineer
